qwen.prompt: This is a rough colour blockout of a video game screen seen from above at an angle. Render it as a finished, detailed 3D scene: pre-rendered 1999 PlayStation field-map CG of an abandoned factory interior, machines still running, dust and dim work lights, no people. The light grey floor with dark seams is worn concrete plates; the dark striped patches are steel floor grates; the khaki blocks and cylinders are heavy industrial machines, presses, furnaces and tanks, and the dark blue-grey cylinders on them are pipes and exhaust stacks; the dark blocks along the sides and the back are the factory's walls, with two pipe runs along the back wall, which is solid, with no doorway; the near-black is darkness beyond the walls. The open floor stays open, flat and empty, right up to the plain walls, with nothing added on it: no crates, no boxes. Keep the outline, size and position of every shape exactly; only replace the flat colours with detailed realistic materials. No characters, no text.

z.prompt: Photorealistic pre-rendered 1999 PlayStation field-map CG of an abandoned factory interior, machines still running, dust and dim work lights, no people, seen from a high fixed camera.
